This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Trypto Buball]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[species]] was distinguished by their hunched postures, large, three-clawed hands, elongated necks, large [[Color|yellow]] [[eye]]s, dark pink skin, and large moustaches.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a member of this species, [[Trypto Buball]], was present at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Trypto-Buball-Concept-Art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Jake Lunt Davies]]
The species made their debut in the [[2017]] film {{Film|VIII}}, directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]].<ref name="Davies">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/B92lyFJjKx2/|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-03-17|quote=Creature design from The Last Jedi. Internally nicknamed Turkey Guy and played by CFX stalwart Aiden Cook who I had previously incarcerated in the Bobbajo costume on TFA. As ever, thanks Aiden, you’re a star. #starwars #thelastjedi #conceptdesign #creaturedesign #alien #cfx|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/GzR42}}</ref>
